title: The Babysitter's Rule
narration: The family gave me one rule: never open the basement door. Their son asked why I was pretending to be his babysitter, then gave me the basement key. Below, videos showed me explaining that he was my son and my husband repeatedly erased my memory. Headlights arrived. The father entered with a medical bag, saw what I had discovered and filled a syringe. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. He promised that tomorrow I would become the new babysitter—and this time I would receive no key.
